punchline: Same sofas, different backdrop: clouds put comfort first, coins put price first.
thirty_sec: In Mandel and Johnson's 2002 study, one furniture page had a cloud background and the same page had coins. People who saw clouds leaned toward the comfortable, pricier sofa; people who saw coins leaned toward the cheaper one.
question: Right before your next important conversation, what will sit in front of the other person that puts one yardstick first?
key_contrast: Same products, different backdrop, different weighing.
